descriptions.f18b_write_float_802041d4: Write reversed IEEE single-precision bits through external stream writer 0x802047e0. Local 4-byte union models the observed stfs/lwz bit reinterpretation; receiver is an incomplete external type never allocated or constructed here. Callee returns a 32-bit status. This caller forwards r3 unchanged in original bytes, but its semantic return typedef and signedness remain unknown; provisional unsigned signature only.
